# A diff compiles a second build of the same unit, so it cannot be asked of
# artifacts that were built elsewhere: there is nothing to vary.
! exec cudalineinfo -diff -use_fast_math -sass $TESTDATA/fused_gate.sass -ptx $TESTDATA/fused_gate.ptx $TESTDATA/fused_gate.cu
stderr '-diff compiles a second build'

! exec cudalineinfo -diff -use_fast_math -cubin $TESTDATA/fused_gate.cubin -ptx $TESTDATA/fused_gate.ptx $TESTDATA/fused_gate.cu
stderr '-diff compiles a second build'

# Compiling needs an architecture, and says so rather than guessing one.
! exec cudalineinfo -diff -use_fast_math $TESTDATA/fused_gate.cu
stderr 'needs -arch'
